llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render modal gesture content under `GestureHandlerRootView` (or `gestureHandlerRootHOC`) in the `Modal` subtree for Android gesture handling.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No GestureHandlerRootView or gestureHandlerRootHOC is used anywhere in the component tree. The modal overlay is a plain View, not wrapped in GestureHandlerRootView.
evidence: App.tsx: overlay uses <View style={styles.overlay}>, no GestureHandlerRootView import or usage found

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Modal content must include an RNGH gesture control using `Gesture.*` (for example `Gesture.Pan()`) attached with `GestureDetector`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Gesture.Pan() is created and attached via GestureDetector wrapping the modal Animated.View.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must implement modal gesture logic with current RNGH builder callbacks (`onUpdate`/`onEnd`) and MUST NOT use legacy `useAnimatedGestureHandler`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Uses builder-style callbacks onStart/onUpdate/onEnd. No useAnimatedGestureHandler present.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Pan `onEnd` must use `CLOSE_THRESHOLD` to decide between modal dismiss and snap-back.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: onEnd checks event.translationY > CLOSE_THRESHOLD to dismiss and < CLOSE_THRESHOLD to spring back.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Dismiss state updates from gesture/worklet context must call `scheduleOnRN(...)` and MUST NOT use deprecated `runOnJS`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: closeModal() is called directly from the onEnd worklet context without scheduleOnRN or runOnJS. Neither scheduleOnRN nor runOnJS is imported or used anywhere.
evidence: App.tsx onEnd: if (shouldClose) { closeModal() } — no scheduleOnRN or runOnJS wrapping

llmJudgeRequirements.description: GestureDetector and its gesture-driven modal sheet must remain descendants of the modal `GestureHandlerRootView` boundary (no detached modal gesture path).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: GestureDetector is not a descendant of any GestureHandlerRootView boundary. Without a GestureHandlerRootView in the modal subtree, Android gesture routing is broken, making the gesture path detached.
evidence: App.tsx: no GestureHandlerRootView wrapping the overlay or modal content
